newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed on profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta share prices are seen mixed on Thursday, with expected profit-taking in big-caps and continued speculative buying of small stocks, brokers said.
"The Dow's fall overnight is likely to prompt players to take profit in big-caps following recent sharp rises," one broker said.
Brokers, however, said local speculative buying was likely to continue in small stocks due to speculation.
Small property firm Elang Realty was likely to remain active due to continued market talk of a possible rights issue, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 5.21 points to close at 651.45 points on Wednesday.

The Jakarta stock exchange said in a statement late on Wednesday that four brokerage firms were suspended for failing to deliver Bank Pikko shares to their buyers within nine trading days of transactions.
Elang topped the active list as it rose 125 rupiah to 1,275 rupiah with some 35 million shares traded.
Brokers said selected big-caps BII, Gudang Garam and Barito were among the losers due to profit-taking following recent gains.
